osmTags.inscription: Le 18 décembre 1943, au n°6 de cette place, dénommée alors Place Lonné, a été arrêté le Chanoine Joseph BORDES, héroïque aumônier de 34ème R.I. de 1914 à 1918, alias « Saint-Père » dans la Résistance (réseau ALLIANCE), déporté à BUCHNWALD ...

eras.label: Mapped site · auto T1
eras.summary: Location and terrain only. OpenStreetMap has no mapped outline for this site.
eras.basis: Everything drawn is traced from OpenStreetMap ways (ODbL) and the Terrarium elevation tiles. Each element names its OSM way.
eras.conjecture: Walls and buildings without a sourced height are drawn as kerb-high plan lines, never as masses. Closed walls have no gates: none are mapped. The DEM is ~30 m source resolution: it cannot show terraces, ditches or scarps. Nothing historic is depicted.

notes: site: osm:relation/7303388 historic=building Q3145665 185 m from ledger point
site is a site relation of 3 parts and none of them outlines the whole site, so no outline is drawn; the scene is fitted to the parts (28 x 30 m)

roads capped: kept the 150 longest of 172 mapped (trace size budget); minor lanes are not drawn
